name: Reforged in the Pit of Saron

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

summary: In the Pit of Saron, the quest sets the old blade against saronite: five infused bars and a forgehammer remake its broken length. The mine is a place of forced labor beneath Icecrown, its black ore cut from a frozen wound. This is a player objective, not a separate campaign of named smiths. When the pieces are joined, the sword is whole again—but the material that holds it also carries a peril.
